II. GENERAL INFORMATION ABOUT THE COLLECTION AND PROCESSING OF YOUR DATA 1. Scope of processing In principle, we process personal data only insofar as this is necessary to provide a functioning website and our content and services. The processing of personal data takes place regularly only with consent. An exception applies to cases in which prior consent can not be obtained for reasons of fact and the processing of the data is permitted by law. 2. Legal basis The processing of your data is either based on your consent or in case the processing is necessary for the performance of a contract to which you are a party, or in order to take steps at your request prior to entering into a contract, or based on legitimate interest, cf. GDPR art. 6(1)(a)-(b), (f). If the processing is based on your consent, you may at any time withdraw your consent by contacting us using the contact information in clause 1. 3. Storage and deletion of your data In principle, we only store personal data for as long as is necessary to fulfill contractual or legal obligations for which we collected the data. After that, we delete the data immediately, unless we still need the data until the expiry of the statutory limitation period for evidence purposes for claims under civil law or due to statutory retention obligations. We delete or block the personal data of the data subject as soon as the purpose of the storage is fulfilled. It may also be stored if provided for by the European or national legislator in EU regulations, laws or regulations to which our company is subject (see details in sections 3.1-3.3). Blocking or deletion of the data also takes place when a storage period prescribed by the standards mentioned expires, unless there is a need for further storage of the data for conclusion of a contract or fulfillment of the contract. 3.1. Data Retention Policy Due to tax regulations, Account Data will be retained for up to five full fiscal years from your cancellation of your Cookiebot CMP account. Configuration Data and System Generated Data will be erased immediately when you cancel the Cookiebot CMP account. End User Data will be erased on an ongoing basis after 12 months from registration, and immediately when you cancel the Cookiebot CMP account. 3.2 Data Retention for Compliance with Legal Requirements You may not require Usercentrics to change any of the default retention periods, except for the reasons for erasure pursuant to clause 3.3, but you may suggest changes for compliance with specific sector laws and regulations. 3.3 Data Restitution and/or Deletion No data except Account Data will be retained after the termination of the Agreement. You may request a data copy before termination. You must not cancel the Cookiebot CMP account until the data copy has been delivered, as Usercentrics will not otherwise be able to deliver the data copy. III. PROVISION OF THE WEBSITE AND CREATION OF LOG FILES 1. Scope of data processing Usercentrics processes personal data only if this is necessary to provide a functioning website and our content and services. The processing of personal data takes place regularly only with consent. An exception applies to cases in which prior consent can not be obtained for reasons of fact and the processing of the data is permitted by law. Any of the information we collect from you may be used for one or more of the following purposes: 1.1. To personalize your experience (the information will help Usercentrics better respond to your individual needs); 1.2. To improve our website (Usercentrics continually strives to improve our website offerings based on the information and feedback we receive from you); 1.3. To establish a primary channel of communication with you; 1.4. To enable you to scan your website for trackers; 1.5. To enable you to talk to an expert. 2. Data processed 2.1 Each time our website is accessed, our system automatically collects data and information from the computer system of the calling computer. E.g. this is information like – Information about the type and version of your internet browser, – The operating system of your computer or smartphone, – Your internet service provider, – Your IP address, – Date and time of your access, – Geographic location, – Websites from which you came to us, – Websites that you visit from our site; We collect such technical information in so-called “log files”, so that you can display our website correctly and we can identify the causes of any technical problems, for the technical optimization of our websites and for the purpose of the security of our computer systems and networks. For these purposes, the legal basis is legitimate interest in the processing of data according to GDPR art. 6(1)(f). The data will be deleted as soon as it is no longer necessary for the purpose of its collection. Typically, this technical information will be erased or rendered unrecognizable at the latest after seven days. The collection of data for the provision of the website and the storage of the data in log files is essential for the operation of the website. 2.2 Each time you use our Service to scan your website, your email address will be processed and definitions of the cookies found when the Service has scanned your website(s), including reports on the result of each scan. IV. CONTACT REQUEST

Playtech has the technology, content and expertise you need, whatever the product. Who we are Playtech Values Integrity We are dedicated to promoting diversity, inclusion and equal opportunities. Our aims include improving the gender balance, encouraging the rise of new female talents, supporting adult career changes and fostering talent among people with physical disabilities. Read our blog Innovation We endeavour to be at the forefront of innovation and set the industry trends Excellence We strive for excellence in everything we do, we aim to offer excellent products and services and be excellent in our interactions Performance We deliver outstanding expectations as well as performance to customers and shareholders Learn more Global scale We’re committed to building a better future 7400 Employees 30+ Locations 150+ Global business customers 40+ Regulated markets 300+ Gaming brands powered Product Suite Giving unprecedented flexibility to clients, our products work together as an entire platform or independently and can be easily integrated with existing platforms. BetBuddy Offering a state-of-art safer gambling analytics platform designed to protect your players and support responsible player engagement and operations. Sustainability: Shaping our sustainable future At Playtech, we are embedding sustainability in the DNA of our company, and throughout our industry. We believe betting and gaming plays a vital role in the global entertainment sector. By championing sustainability and operating responsibly, we are striving to have a positive impact on our customers, colleagues, communities, and planet. What does sustainability mean at Playtech? Sustainability is about taking responsibility for our impact on people, society, and the environment. In practice, this means we are: Continually evolving our strategy and ways of working to make Playtech resilient enough to thrive in the long-term Making sustainability targets a core part of our business-planning process Playing a leading role in the movement to build a more responsible, sustainable gambling industry You can find more information on our sustainability strategy and efforts on our website under the Sustainability tab, or in our annual report. Annual Report Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging Here at Playtech, we embrace different cultures, genders, ethnicities, backgrounds, and beliefs. We always promote respect and inclusion and protect our employees. This is what makes us who we are and what continues to help us grow as a successful, socially responsible, global organisation. We recognise that diversity is found in any social identity, such as gender, age, culture, nationality, ethnicity, physical abilities, political and religious beliefs, sexual orientation, and other attributes. We believe, inclusion is the process of involving, accepting, and valuing all people in the workplace regardless of their differences and social identity. To create a place where everybody can bring their whole self to work and freely express their opinion! Wellbeing @Playtech We want wellbeing to be at the centre of our culture. We create an inclusive workplace that allow our people to feel valued, cared for and listened to. We understand the different factors that influence wellbeing, Playtech classifies wellbeing into the following four “Pillars of Wellbeing”: Physical Wellbeing Social Wellbeing Mental Wellbeing Financial Wellbeing These pillars provide us with a basis for all our wellbeing initiatives, to celebrate our achievements, and reach our wellbeing goals! Our communities and the environment At Playtech, our Global Community Investment programme drives meaningful change in the communities we call home. We make an impact in two important ways: our local Community Investment committees coordinate impactful donation projects in each region, and every employee receives a paid volunteer day annually to give back and support causes they’re passionate about. By partnering with local organizations, we create meaningful connections while addressing community needs. Watch our inspiring video to see Playtech volunteers in action! Sustainable Gambling Playtech is committed to designing, developing and delivering high-quality, effective safe gambling products and services to our licensees and raising standards for player protection. For us, responsible business practices are the right thing to do, as well as being increasingly important requirements in order to be able to operate in a wide-variety of markets. Protecting players from harmful play is also vital for the long-term success of our business and that of our licensees. That is why we continue to put ethical principles at the heart of our business and promote safer gambling through: Compliance Customer engagement Data analytics Proactiveness Fair marketing Research At Playtech, we are committed to deliver innovative science-led solutions and technology that protect our customers, players and employees. jobs.title: How we hire
jobs.description: How we hire We hire people, not resumes When someone takes the time to show an interest in working with us we take their candidate experience very seriously. Our process focuses on how we get to know you, what motivates you, and where we can support your growth. View open roles Your journey Hiring is a two way conversation – you’re interviewing us as well. Throughout the process, you’ll get a real insight into the kind of work you’ll be doing at Playtech. Our first tip for applicants: be yourself! Playtech celebrates individuality and all the diverse talents and experiences that people bring to our team. Visit life at Playtech Playtech’s pro tips Tips for success Review Application Your application is the first thing our recruiters see about you. Make sure to double-check it before pressing “submit.” We want you to show up at your best: Look for grammar and spelling mistakes, take time to accurately answer our pre-qualifying questions and make sure your employment information is accurate. Be Yourself We want to get to know the real candidate. We want to know more than just your resume. Take the time to read directions through your candidate experience – like the application and any correspondence from a recruiter. Take every opportunity show us who you really are — we value what makes you unique. Do Your Research Before your interview, research the people you are meeting — LinkedIn is a great place to start. Think about what in your background might be of interest to them. Prepare some questions that are specific to each interviewer based on their experience and role. Putting thought into your questions is a great way to show that you have done your research. Learn more Learn about Playtech Spend some time learning about Playtech. Talk to friends, read news articles and review our career site. This will help you get a sense of what we are all about, and what we value as a company. This knowledge will go a long way as you prepare for your interview. Learn more Want in? Here's the deal Step by step into how our hiring process works STEP ONE Apply online Applying for a new job or career path can take a lot of effort and pressing “submit” on an application can be daunting. We get that — and we want the process to be as easy as possible STEP TWO Meet a Talent Acquisition Partner So, you’ve applied online or we’ve reached out to you. What’s the next step? We’ll have a chat about your aspirations and experience, and also talk more about the role and Playtech’s culture. We’ll also work through a few short questions to assess your knowledge of the role you’re applying for, and how you approach certain problems. This is your chance to ask questions too, so ask as many as you’d like. STEP THREE Interview/Test During the interview process at Playtech, you will have the opportunity to meet not only the Talent Acquisition Partner but also the team members with whom you would potentially work closely. We aim to replicate the Playtech working environment, so you’ll dive in with team members and tackle tasks related to your role. We want to get a sense of how we’d work together, so explaining your thinking and asking questions are a key part of the session. STEP FOUR Pre-employment Checks The recruitment process in Playtech includes pre-employment checks, which our partners contractually require Playtech to perform. These steps will take place after the test and/or interview rounds and before moving to the official offer stage. Playtech uses third-party service providers who will reach out to you on our behalf, to collect information on the needed checks. We will notify you which provider will contact you, as it depends upon jurisdictions that are in scope. Due to different local applicability, the exact scope of pre-employment checks do vary. The checks we potentially require during the standard recruitment process are: professional reference, ID check, right to work and criminal background checks. For the roles we consider critical at Playtech we might conduct additional checks like: qualification and adverse finance checks (anti-money laundering). The criticality of a role is defined internally and depends on the job role and the responsibility it carries. Necessary background check steps will be introduced to you by the responsible Talent Acquisition Partner. Once the pre-employment checks has been completed, the Talent Acquisition Partner will inform you about it. Your privacy is important to us. Please read this Privacy Notice carefully regarding our processing practices for recruitment and if at any time, you have questions or concerns about our privacy practices, please feel free to contact us at People@playtech.com. STEP FIVE Decision We’re making a decision, but we know that you are too. Here are some more reasons to join, just in case you’re still asking yourself “Why Playtech”. Remember, we’re not just looking for people who will “fit in”— we want people who will contribute fresh and innovative ideas to our company culture. We know you are excited and interested in how your application is doing, but sometimes the recruitment process takes time. We will not leave you waiting too long and never leave our applicants without any feedback. We will contact you as soon as possible.
